I'm 73 and had a routine blood test showing low white blood cells. A blood smear was ordered, and my doctor said it might be a viral reaction. I've had health issues before and am worried—could this be a sign of blood cancer? Can blood tests like these detect cancer early?

I'm 73 and I woke up at 4:30 a.m. with a sharp, throbbing pain that made it hard to move. I stayed in bed and didn’t get up. By 6 a.m., the pain had gone and I felt fine. I'm 70 and have been feeling extremely fatigued for about a year, despite having regular checkups and no diagnosed conditions. I'm active and eat well, but I just can't seem to get energy. I'm 72 and have had persistent pain on my right side—eye, cheek, and nose—for about three weeks. It’s sharp and extremely painful to touch the sinus area, which I’ve never experienced before. I'm 70 and have been experiencing severe joint pain, especially in my knees and shoulders, along with constant fatigue and numbness in my legs for over two years. I'm 73 and have been noticing a strong sulfur or rotten egg smell for about two weeks. I'm 74 and every time I go to the bathroom and finish urinating, I feel like my brain goes blank for a second or two. I'm not dizzy, but I can't think clearly during that time. It's been happening for months. Is this a sign of something serious or just a normal reaction?

I'm 72 and have been taking codeine for muscle spasms in my upper back for over 20 years.
